name: Troubleshooting, debugging and RCA
note: Questions authored by Claude as practice material. Not sourced from your own notes or any official exam. Verify anything you doubt against the docs.

questions.q: What is the first step when a defect is reported?
options: Reproduce it reliably and note exact steps and environment
Ask for a retest next sprint
questions.why: No reliable repro, no reliable diagnosis.

questions.q: Browser shows an error. Where do you look to see whether the API failed?
questions.why: Network shows request, status code and payload.

questions.q: Which is a root cause rather than a symptom?
options: The webhook handler skips records with a null Cms_Id
questions.why: A root cause explains why the symptom occurs.

questions.q: In the 5 Whys technique, you stop when:
options: You reach a cause you can fix or control
You find a person to blame
questions.why: The number five is a guide, not a rule.

questions.q: What does git bisect help with?
options: Finding the commit that introduced a regression
questions.why: It binary-searches history between a good and a bad commit.
